output.summary: I arrived on the boat this morning with 40 coins and three nights paid at the inn, planning to ease into things and work. I had soup for 2 and bread for 1, slept at the inn. I met Ivana at the inn; we talked about the rain and waves. Later, at the council hall, the council chose me as mayor, which surprised me. Petar was there, checking the ledger for repairs, and I saw water pooling by the east steps; I mentioned it and he said he'd pass it on. I didn't get to the chandlery for a clerk job, and I haven't checked on work openings yet. The treasury is mine to spend, and I want to use it wisely for the inn and the island.

output.summary: Today I worked as a field hand at the hill fields and was paid 2 coins. I bought bread twice and ate one of them, but the other I still have. I didn't make it to the bakery in the morning, so I missed that chance to ask Petar for work. I did talk to Rosa and Petar briefly about the weather and the inn, but I didn't really get to know the townspeople or the mayor. I have 38 coins and a job now, so income is less of a worry, but I still need to build trust.
